stored_content: Document versions and extracted raw text
Document chunks (content, index, metadata_json, tenant_id, department_id)
Chunk embeddings (vector, embedding_version, dimensions, provider, model)
authoritative_source_of_truth.recovery_method: Full database restore from verified pg_dump

qdrant_vector_store.rebuild_strategy: Iterate over document_chunks and chunk_embeddings in PostgreSQL to re-upsert into Qdrant collections ({collection}_{dims}) with tenant and department payload filters. Zero data loss.

local_filesystem_storage.content: Raw uploaded source files (PDF, DOCX, XLSX, etc.)
local_filesystem_storage.backup_strategy: Tar/zip archive synchronized to S3/R2 or persistent disk snapshot
local_filesystem_storage.fallback: Extracted text and chunks are permanently preserved in PostgreSQL document_versions and document_chunks even if raw binary is lost.
